conclusion: forall task i and every considered LO-mode job J_i, RT(J_i) <= R_i^LO when the displayed recurrence inequality holds
exact_statement: For every constrained-deadline sporadic task i in a single-processor fully-preemptive fixed-priority reference schedule, let R_i^LO be a natural-number candidate satisfying R_i^LO >= C_i(LO) + sum_{j in hp(i)} ceil(R_i^LO/T_j) C_j(LO). If the task, processor, release, execution and integer-tick assumptions hold, every considered LO-mode job of task i has response time at most R_i^LO.
